name: POST /api/geo/merge - Merge two canonical addresses
manualReason: The winner+loser addresses being present is necessary but NOT sufficient: the happy path cannot return 200 in ANY environment due to a code-level FK-ordering defect. mergeAddresses (packages/sdk-geo/src/services/geoService.ts:241-247) INSERTs a geo.merge_event (winner_address_id, loser_address_id) and then DELETEs the loser geo.address row in the same non-transactional flow. But merge_event_loser_address_id_fkey is FOREIGN KEY(loser_address_id) REFERENCES geo.address ON DELETE RESTRICT, so the merge_event row just inserted blocks its own loser delete -> Postgres raises 23503 on the DELETE, which the handler (routes.ts) surfaces as 500 InternalError (its 23503 catch only maps the INSERT-side violation to 404). Verified against http://127.0.0.1:3000 with two pristine seeded addresses (no prior merge_event): still 500. This is a product bug outside test-data control; the source FK should be ON DELETE SET NULL / CASCADE, or the loser delete removed, before this can be auto-tested. To exercise it manually once fixed, seed two geo.address rows (street/city/country are NOT NULL) and pass their ids as winner_address_id / loser_address_id with a valid signup-tenant bearer token.
description: Merges two canonical addresses: every alias of the loser is re-pointed at the winner, a geo.merge_event audit row is written, and the loser geo.address row is deleted. Both ids must be well-formed UUIDs - the handler pre-validates the format so a malformed id cannot reach Postgres. Edge cases: a syntactically valid but non-existent winner or loser trips the merge_event foreign key (23503), which the handler maps to 404; passing the same id as winner and loser is not blocked and self-deletes the row; the operation is destructive and NOT idempotent - replaying the same merge 404s the second time because the loser no longer exists; operator_id is optional and defaults to null; requires a valid JWT.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
winner_address_id or loser_address_id is absent or empty
winner_address_id or loser_address_id does not match the UUID regex

errorCases.message: winner or loser address not found
errorCases.when: merge_event insert raises Postgres FK violation 23503 - a referenced address row does not exist
Any other failure during the alias re-point / merge_event insert / loser delete sequence
